title.value: ELLIS PhD Program: Call for Applications 2026
title.evidence_quote: ELLIS PhD Program: Call for Applications 2026

institution.name: ELLIS (European Laboratory for Learning and Intelligent Systems)

description_short: ELLIS has opened its 2026 PhD Program call for entry in 2027. Applicants apply online through the ELLIS application portal; reference requests must be submitted before the deadline, and the network spans European AI labs with an international exchange component.
status_evidence: Official ELLIS announcement: apply online through the ELLIS application portal by 31 October 2026, 23:59 AoE (future)
ELLIS homepage, as shown in search results, says the portal is open for 2027 entrants
uncertainties: Evidence seen through web-search results of the official page; the page itself could not be fetched from this environment
mlscientist.com listing seen through web-search results only (site unreachable from this environment)
Program spans several European countries; no single host country, so location left null
ELLIS announcement wording on the reference-request date is inconsistent (31 October vs 1 November)
mlscientist.com listing gave 15 November 2026, which the official page contradicts; official 31 October used
